title: Request Record Clause: the Customer’s Closure of a Commission
content:
# Request Record Clause: the Customer's Closure of a Commission

Where a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is to be closed at the customer's request, the customer's own closure of that commission, and their acceptance of the sum the studio will keep, are taken down on the design studio's request record. Walking away from a piece being made for them is the customer's own act. The sum the studio keeps is settled only after the commission's entries carry the repricing due where the metal price behind the quote has aged past the programme's revaluation window.

Read the other way: while the commission's entries do not yet carry that repricing, due where the metal price behind the quote has aged past the programme's revaluation window, the sum the studio keeps is not yet settled.

## The result this clause governs

A request record standing as confirmed by the customer against that commission and against the customer's own file, carrying the sum the customer accepts the studio will keep and the date they wish the closure to take effect from. The commission's own quoted total, balance and stage are untouched; what the customer sees afterwards is a confirmed closure request on their file that the studio may settle against.

## How the closure is taken

The closure is taken on the customer's own tool `confirm_commission_closure_3c2f355d`. The tool is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves; the desk does not run it for them.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `custom_order_id` | The commission record being closed | An identifier, as read from the design studio's commission lookup for this customer |
| `customer_id` | The customer closing the commission | An identifier, as read from the customer lookup that found the caller |
| `commission_reference` | The reference the customer is given for the commission being closed | CO- followed by six digits, for example CO-509314, exactly as it stands on the commission record |
| `retained_amount` | The sum the customer accepts the studio will keep on the closure | In USD, to 2 decimal places, rounded half up, positive, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol |
| `effective_date` | The calendar date the customer wishes the closure to take effect from | YYYY-MM-DD in the studio's own local time, never left empty |

## What comes back

A single line of text confirming the closure request was taken. It names the new request record's reference number, the commission reference it concerns, the sum confirmed in USD to two decimal places and the effective date as YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving that line is what indicates the confirmation now stands on the studio's request record.
